ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.15:0.85 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity pixels across the central and proximal fluke regions; distinct high-intensity (white) contiguous blobs localized at the distal lateral tips of both lobes; diffused mottling/speckling along the dorsal-trailing margins of the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an approximate 110-degree aperture and a clearly defined central vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, with higher amplitude variations towards the distal lobe extremities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch transitioning into a convex sweep towards the outer lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly concentrated circular high-contrast pixel clusters at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically-to-diagonally oriented light-colored linear pixel disruptions detected on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, ragged physical boundaries at the lateral tips with associated dense white focal scarring.
